master_character_prompt: A man in his mid-forties, lean and slightly stooped from decades spent sitting still at the roadside, a broad, deeply lined face marked by permanent creases at the mouth and eyes, sun-cracked olive-brown skin, coarse dark hair heavily streaked with gray and cropped close, a short unkempt beard flecked with gray. His eyes are dark brown, deep-set beneath heavy lids — in every scene before he washes at Siloam, a faint gray-white film clouds the iris and his gaze drifts unfocused, aimed slightly past whatever is near him; in every scene after, that film is gone and his eyes are clear, alert, taking in the ordinary world with the sober astonishment of a grown man seeing it for the first time. He wears a patched, undyed sand-colored wool beggar's tunic, coarse-woven and frayed at the hem, a simple rope belt, and dusty, calloused bare feet. Painterly warm 2D illustration style, Mediterranean palette, ochre and sandstone tones, cinematic lighting. card_prompts.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a sunlit Jerusalem street beside a stone gate, fine dust hanging in the morning air. A few paces off, a small group of men has stopped mid-stride; one of them, a man in a simple first-century tunic, seen from behind, face never visible, stands turned fully toward the beggar while the others gesture among themselves in debate — his own footprints, alone among the group, have left the dust undisturbed.
